figures.finding: A child (under fifteen) or a minor still in compulsory primary school may take paid part in filming, advertising, preparing and performing artistic, stage or similar cultural works only with the prior approval of the social welfare authority, asked for by the legal representative at least 15 days before and decided within ten days, a copy going to the labour inspectorate; the hours, daily and weekly duration and rests may not endanger health or schooling nor be less favourable than article 68.a's limits (for those of fourteen and over out of school, 7 hours a day and 35 a week in holiday work, 8 and 40 for minors, 14 hours' daily rest); no lowest age is set; anyone in regular contact with the child must have no conviction for sexual offences against children; 'snimanje filmova' and 'izvođenje umjetničkih ... djela' reach a child taking part in a film, not by their words a young writer or director.

value.permit: prethodno odobrenje tijela nadležnog za poslove socijalne skrbi
value.limits: not less favourable than art. 68.a (7h/35h; 8h/40h for minors; 14h daily rest)

Zahtjev iz stavka 6. ovoga članka zakonski zastupnik djeteta i maloljetnika podnosi u roku od 15 dana prije početka njegova sudjelovanja u aktivnostima iz stavka 5. ovoga članka, a tijelo nadležno za poslove socijalne skrbi o zahtjevu je dužno riješiti u roku od deset dana od dana njegova podnošenja.
niti smiju biti nepovoljniji od trajanja i ograničenja propisanih člankom 68.a ovoga Zakona.
dijete s navršenih 14 godina koje više ne pohađa obvezno osnovno obrazovanje ne smije obavljati poslove duže od sedam sati dnevno i 35 sati tjedno
Osobe iz stavaka 1. i 2. ovoga članka imaju pravo na dnevni odmor od najmanje 14 sati neprekidno tijekom vremenskog razdoblja od 24 sata.

figures.finding: A minor of fifteen or more, out of compulsory primary school, whom the legal representative authorises for a particular employment contract has capacity to make and end it and to take all legal steps under it, save acts needing the social welfare authority's approval; the representative may withdraw or limit it; a child's paid part in filming needs the authority's approval as above; no rule setting aside earnings was found; the authorisation is for any employment, writing and directing included.

value.binding: legal representative's authorisation from 15 (art. 20); social-welfare approval for children in filming (art. 19.a)

sources.said: Ako zakonski zastupnik ovlasti maloljetnika s petnaest godina i starijeg od petnaest godina za sklapanje određenog ugovora o radu, osim maloljetnika koji pohađa obvezno osnovno obrazovanje, maloljetnik je poslovno sposoban za sklapanje i raskidanje toga ugovora
Zakonski zastupnik može povući ili ograničiti ovlaštenje iz stavka 1. ovoga članka, odnosno u ime maloljetnika raskinuti radni odnos.

figures.finding: Any natural person with full legal capacity may be a member of a joint-stock company's management board, so not a minor (majority, and full capacity, at eighteen); the d.o.o.'s rule wasn't read.

sources.said: Članom uprave može biti svaka fizička osoba koja je potpuno poslovno sposobna.

figures.finding: The Croatian Film Directors' Guild (DHFR) admits as regular members directors who submit proof of at least one feature, three shorts, 9 minutes of animation or four episodes of a TV drama; it states no age.

DHFR.work: 1 feature, or 3 shorts, or 9 min animation, or 4 TV drama episodes

sources.said: – najmanje jedan dugometražni film, ili – najmanje tri kratkometražna filma, ili – najmanje 9 minuta animiranog filma, ili – najmanje 4 epizode dramske TV serije.
